rationale: The Court is likely to reverse on Egbert/Abbasi grounds: this is a new Bivens context and the existence of an executive remedial framework plus prison-administration separation-of-powers concerns supplies at least one rational reason to hesitate, even if officers allegedly obstructed the process in this case. Separate writings are most likely from Thomas (to reiterate skepticism of implied causes of action) and from the dissenters (to argue obstruction creates a remedial vacuum and Carlson should control).
